map.title: World maps
map.boundary: Maps are author annotations, not committed story facts. Maps and images remain in this project and are included in full backups.
map.empty: No maps yet. Create a blank map or import your own background image.
map.backup: Full backups include maps. Lightweight backups may omit original images.
map.name: Map name
map.instructions: Choose a location, then click to add a pin. Drag pins to move them. Click vertices for a route or a region (at least three), then finish drawing. Coordinates use an independent fictional 0–1000 system.
map.noSummary: No summary yet. Edit it in the location entry.
map.referenceHint: Use the knowledge center for existing reverse links and source evidence.
map.selectPin: Select a pin to see its location summary, source links and map hierarchy.
map.noLinkedMaps: No map pins yet. Add this location in World maps.
map.conflictHelp: Another window saved a newer version. Your edits are kept; download the draft before reloading. No forced overwrite.
map.imageMissing: The background is unavailable. Pins remain editable; check whether the backup included original images.
map.repairLocation: The location is unavailable. Rebind this pin to an existing location or remove it; no entry is invented.
map.removeConfirm: Remove this map and its pins and routes? Location entries and background assets are preserved. Undo before saving, or use existing revision history afterward.
map.reloadConfirm: Reloading discards unsaved edits and unfinished drawing. Download a draft first, or cancel to keep editing.
map.drawingUnfinished: Finish or cancel the current route/region before saving maps.
map.switchConfirm: The current route/region is unfinished. Switching discards this drawing but keeps completed map edits. Download a draft containing the unfinished points first.

audio.title: Chapter audio export
audio.local: Offline Windows SAPI synthesis to one WAV per chapter. Manuscripts are not uploaded. Voice quality depends on installed system voices.
audio.installVoice: Install a speech pack for the language in Windows Settings, then check again. Text editing remains available.
audio.drafts: Explicitly include drafts without a final manuscript
audio.confirmRange: Synthesize {{count}} chapters, named by volume and chapter. Source manuscripts are preserved.
audio.estimates: Duration and size: this voice does not expose a reliable estimation API, so pre-export estimates are unknown. Actual duration and file size are shown after each chapter.
audio.empty: No audio exports yet. Choose a local voice, chapters and an output folder.
audio.historyWarning: Skipped {{count}} damaged records without deleting them. History reads the latest 200 and displays 50; other features remain available.
audio.emptyScope: No chapters to export yet. Write a manuscript or explicitly include drafts.
audio.sampleEstimate: Reference estimate: about {{minutes}} minutes / {{size}}, based on {{count}} characters already synthesized in this project with the same voice and rate. Language and punctuation change duration; actual size may differ.
audio.pollFailed: Progress could not be read; the export may still be running. Retry status without starting synthesis again.

versionsSelectChapter: Open a manuscript chapter first, then manage its parallel versions here. Alternatives are excluded from default metrics, search and exports.

errors.MAP_STALE: Maps changed. Keep your edits and reload before saving.
errors.MAP_PARENT: The parent map no longer exists.
errors.MAP_CYCLE: Map hierarchy cannot contain a cycle.
errors.MAP_PIN_ID: Pin IDs must be unique within a map.
errors.MAP_LOCATION: A location was removed or does not belong to this project.
errors.MAP_CHILD: The linked map no longer exists.
errors.MAP_SHAPE_ID: Route and region IDs must be unique.
errors.MAP_LIMIT: Map annotations exceed the 2 MiB limit. Split the data into smaller maps.
errors.AUDIO_VOICE: The selected Windows speech voice is no longer available.
errors.AUDIO_TIMEOUT: Local speech synthesis timed out. Verified completed chapters can be kept when resuming.
errors.AUDIO_EMPTY: The voice did not produce any audio frames.
errors.AUDIO_NOT_FOUND: This audio export could not be found.
errors.AUDIO_PROTECTED_DIRECTORY: Choose an output folder outside the manuscript and software workspace.
errors.AUDIO_SYMLINK: The output folder cannot pass through a symbolic link or junction.
errors.AUDIO_LIMIT: This export is too large. Export one volume or a smaller chapter selection.
errors.AUDIO_CONFIRM: Confirm the local voice, chapter selection and output folder first.
errors.AUDIO_UNAVAILABLE: Install or choose a Windows speech voice before exporting.
errors.AUDIO_BUSY: Another audio export is running. Wait or cancel it first.
errors.AUDIO_RESTORED: Restored audio records are read-only. Create a new export in the restored project.
errors.AUDIO_NOT_RESUMABLE: This task does not need to be resumed.
errors.AUDIO_SOURCE_CHANGED: The manuscript scope or version changed. Create a new export; old audio cannot represent new text.
errors.AUDIO_PREVIEW_EXPIRED: The audio preview expired. Review the chapter scope again.
errors.AUDIO_PREVIEW_CHANGED: The scope or voice settings changed. Preview again before exporting.
errors.AUDIO_CLOSING: The application is closing; no new export was started.
errors.AUDIO_LOCAL_ONLY: Choose a local disk folder. Offline exports do not access network shares.
errors.MAP_DAMAGED: The map file is damaged or uses an unsupported version. It was preserved; restore it through Data Center revision history.
errors.MAP_SELF_LINK: A pin cannot link the current map to itself as a child.
errors.AUDIO_EMPTY_SCOPE: The scope contains no exportable manuscript. Select chapters or explicitly include drafts.
errors.AUDIO_OUTPUT_CONFLICT: Too many filename collisions. Existing files were kept; choose another output folder.
